def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Any 2 within/adjacent to a green rectangle is a seed; exterior 2s are noise and stay put.
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=2: continue
        # marker if its cell is enclosed in the bounding box of a green component
        # (component rectangle is the connected 3 region, ignoring marker holes)
        seen=set(); stack=[]
        for y in range(h):
          for x in range(w):
            if grid[y][x]==3 and (y,x) not in seen:
              comp=[]; stack=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x))
              while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                  q=(a+da,b+db)
                  if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==3 and q not in seen:
                    seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
              ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
              if min(ys)<=r<=max(ys) and min(xs)<=c<=max(xs) and max(ys)-min(ys)>1 and max(xs)-min(xs)>1:
                if min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for a,b in comp)<=1:
                  for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(h,r+2)):
                    for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(w,c+2)):
                      if (rr,cc)!=(r,c): out[rr][cc]=1
                  break
    return out
PY
